::: {#def-nested-regression-models}
#### Nested linear regression models

Let a [linear regression model](#def-linear-regression)
have $p$ features and an [intercept](#def-slr-intercept).
A second linear regression model is **nested** in it
if it uses the same outcome and the same observations
and is the special case in which $q$ of the $p$ coefficients equal $0$.
The first model is the *larger* model,
and the second is the *smaller* model;
the smaller model has $p - q$ features.

Source: @vittinghoff2e [Section 4.3].
:::
